newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian car gang caught in "Operation Testarossa".
newsitem.headline: Italian car gang caught in "Operation Testarossa".

text.p: Police on Tuesday said they had arrested 10 Italians on suspicion of car theft in a swoop codenamed "Operation Testarossa" after Ferrari's flame-red sports car.

Police in Bolzano, northern Italy, said the 10 were suspected of having stolen 44 luxury cars over the past year to sell abroad. Fifteen of the cars had been recovered in Spain and another five found in Italy, a spokesman said.

Investigations began last summer after a Ferrari Testarossa was stolen in Bolzano. Police used film from security cameras placed at motorway toll booths to trace the car to the northern city of Bergamo and enquiries continued from there.
